english.title: Deposit thing on a highway causing injury / danger to user
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, deposited **(..SPECIFY THING..) on a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..), in consequence of which a user of the highway was injured or endangered
english.legislation: Contrary to section 161(1) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority/excuse

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes: See the more serious offence under section 22A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 (offence wording H3254) of causing a thing to be on a road in circumstances that would be dangerous.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant without lawful authority or excuse, deposited **(..SPECIFY THING..) on a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..), in consequence of which a user of the highway was injured or endangered.
